database_name: CoinMarketCap CMC20 Index Governed Quantitative Lake

invariants_verified: 1. Timestamp Monotonicity: ts[i] > ts[i-1] strictly ascending (UTC)
2. Deduplication: 0 duplicate timestamps across all files
3. K-line Geometric Invariant: High >= max(Open, Close) and Low <= min(Open, Close)
4. Positive Price Invariant: All prices and index values > 0
5. Non-negative Volume & Units Invariant: weights >= 0, units >= 0
6. Anti-Lookahead Guarantee: Clean left/right alignment, no future leak
7. Discrete Signal Contract: signal_ensemble, ema, macd, rsi, bb, breadth strictly in {-1, 0, 1}
